---
title: "Interactive Dashboard"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

data <- read.csv("data/final_dataset.csv")

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = economics_uncertainty_index,
                      y = Repetition_Score,
                      text = Country)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3)

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
